verdict.rationale: The evidence shows API access to customers, per-customer monitoring configuration, cases, audit trails, exports and transaction processing. Nothing documents programmatic creation or editing of transaction-monitoring rules such as velocity rules, blocklist or allowlist management via API, or human approval gates on rule or list changes. Screening configurations and risk-score equations are described as configured with compliance teams and the web app, not exposed for agent-driven rule management. The agentic workflows' escalation to human review covers alert triage, not rule governance, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.
